name: Gorrm the Unroped
lore: Gorrm was ko-Ghast until the Moot priced a Kharrow herdsman's death at a hundred head and Ghast would not pay it for him. He did not kill the herdsman; he says so, and the Moot says so now, and it was too late by then. He keeps the Unroped by the one law he still holds with, that a price paid is a price paid, and he has begun paying prices in advance.

phases.name: paid in advance
phases.say: He wraps his broken chain round his fist and calls the price. The ones still standing come.

name: The Keener of Orrdun
lore: Hethra ko-Skarl went up to Orrdun behind the last bier ninety years ago to sing its name in, and when the Breath did not come she sang the name before it, and the one before that, back to the first. She has not stopped. Her voice has gone to a shriek and her hands to claws in the joints of the rock, and she still knows every name in Orrdun in the order it came. If you stand still long enough she will sing yours, and put it in its place.

phases.name: the name before
phases.say: She stops at a name and screams it, and the niches answer. What was lying in them is getting up.

name: The Kneeling Brakh
lore: What the Breath left of a giant who was drinking when it came: the bones kept, the rest taken, and three thousand years of the lake's lime grown over the bones until they could stand again. It still kneels. It still has its hands in the water. Whatever it lifts out of the lake it lets the water carry down to the Skarl, as if it wanted somebody to know it was there.

phases.name: the drinker
phases.say: It lifts its hands out of the lake. The water runs out of them for a long time.

phases.name: stands
phases.say: For the first time in three thousand years it gets off its knees.

name: Kadda the Rasp
lore: Kadda was ko-Kharrow, a tally-cutter's daughter, until the Moot priced her brother's death at her own hands at nine years' work and she would not stay to do them. She knows the Long Tally better than any keeper living: where every clan's wall begins, how the fives are cut, which notch is whose. She grinds the names out with a farrier's rasp, carefully, the way her mother cut them in, and she has kept a list of every one she has taken away, because she cannot bear for anything to be forgotten by accident.

phases.name: unwritten
phases.say: She drags the rasp across the blank wall and shouts the names off her list, and the Unwritten who are left come to hear their own.

name: The Chained Brakh
lore: What the Breath left of a giant who lay down in the fell when the world was young: bone gone to iron, three thousand years of it, so that the Brindle dug its marrow for ore and drew it into the chains that hold the heights together. When the last shift's picks went into its heart it got up. They could not kill it, so they chained it where it stood, with their own last length, and went on digging round it. It has stood in that chain for forty years with the rust running down it like blood.

phases.name: in the chain
phases.say: It turns as far as the chain lets it, and the chain sings against the rock.

phases.name: the last link
phases.say: The last link parts. The chain the Brindle drew from its own marrow comes away in its hand, and it swings it.

name: Haldo the Lampman
lore: Haldo ko-Oskel worked the gloup winch for twenty years and sold the Salt boat's cargo to the clanless the week before it sailed, for more silver than the Oskel paid him in a lifetime, and hung a lamp in the sea-mouth the night it came round the cape. He did not know Keddo was its pilot. He has not been up the gloup since. He lights the lamp on every dark night, the clanless say, because he cannot bear for anyone to think it was an accident.

phases.name: the lamp
phases.say: He takes the lamp off its hook and swings it, and the light goes out over the skerries and back, and the Lamp's men come to it.
